lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity local maxima arranged in roughly vertical columns across the lateral flank, exhibiting a semi-regular grid distribution posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating distinct grid-like anchor nodes on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal features on the upper flank characterized by sharp vertical intensity gradients (light superior, shadowed inferior) running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A dense collection of high-luminance blobs distributed across the visible surface area of the first dorsal fin silhouette, concentrated toward the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, high-chroma yellow pixel clusters located in the water column anterior to the pectoral fin and head region.
